description: Copilot CLI writes one process log per session to ~/.copilot/logs/process-<timestamp>-<pid>.log under the default home. copilot-home-relocation covers COPILOT_HOME.
note: Telltale registers only project-local logs/copilot. Copilot CLI does not publish its log writer, so the path comes from the pinned changelog and the official config-dir reference; the log contents reuse a Telltale fixture, and whether 1.0.101 writes these lines at the default level is unconfirmed.
